title: 👀 Gajjala's Watch — your tickers on 1-, 5- and 15-minute bars from 04:00 ET
full_text: Your watch holds 18 — adding one replaces the one on your watch the longest (never a 🎯 A+)
empty_text: Your watch is empty — add a ticker to see its 1-, 5- and 15-minute charts

info.honesty: A 9-over-21 cross is information, not an entry. UNMEASURED: nothing has measured what follows a cross on these frames.
info.vwap_text: 📈 VWAP on 👀 Gajjala's Watch: the volume-weighted average price of the whole extended session, premarket and after-hours included from 04:00 ET, built from closed 1-min bars (typical price × volume, the house VWAP engine). It restarts every session, runs through after-hours, and its last point is the last closed bar — the live candle does not move it. Display only: nothing gates, sorts or rings on it. UNMEASURED.
info.zones_text: 📐 Daily zones on 👀 Gajjala's Watch: the Supply & Demand engine's daily supply and demand zones (closed daily bars, the board's geometry), the 4 nearest of each kind, drawn dashed where they cross the chart's price range; a zone never moves the price scale. A high or low made in the last 5 closed sessions is not a zone yet — the engine needs 5 later sessions to call it a swing, so yesterday's high is usually not drawn. A name with fewer than 120 daily bars gets none. Display only: nothing gates, sorts or rings on it. UNMEASURED.

auto.title: 🤖 12 of 18 auto from the Gajjala boards
auto.hint: Added once a minute in the pass window: every name that came into a 🧠 potential on the 🚩 5-min, 🚩 1-min and 🧪 boards at any time today with today's volume at or over 1,000,000 shares (GG's K11 floor — the scan row, else the pass's own stored number), up to 18. A current potential goes first; today's earlier ones follow newest first, into free seats only, and one that already read ↩️ back under or ✖️ stop printed is not added. A name stays all session; it leaves when every board reads ↩️ back under or ✖️ stop printed, or on your ×; ⏸ waiting above its trigger stays. At 18 the oldest name whose potential lapsed makes room for a current potential. The 🧪 tag means the 🧪 board shows this 🚩 5-min potential (it borrows them). A name that becomes 🎯 A+ on any of these boards today takes a seat at once, ahead of the potentials — at 18 it displaces the oldest name whose potential lapsed, then the oldest-added potential, never another A+ or your own name — and stays all session; ↩️ back under or ✖️ stop printed never remove it (the 🎯 A+ chip says so). Your own names are never touched. Auto names do not ring the 1-min cross. × removes a name until tomorrow. UNMEASURED.

sections.title: 👤 Your names
sections.hint: Names you added, newest first. Names added before 11-19 carry no time.

sections.title: 🎯 A+
sections.hint: 🤖 added these because a Gajjala board read them A+ this session (or promoted a 🧠 potential when it went A+). They stay all session, a stop included. Your own A+ names stay in 👤 with their 🎯 chip.

sections.title: 🤖 Added today
sections.hint: 🤖 adds this session, newest first — each tile says when it was added. 📅 on a tile = it ran last session (11-12); a label, not why it was added.

sections.title: ✅ All rules met
sections.hint: Every name that met all of Gajjala's rules on the 🚩 5-min, 🚩 1-min and 🧪 board (trigger armed — only the break missing — with the day's volume at or over 1,000,000) and every 🎯 A+, newest first. It stays until 5 sessions pass without it meeting them again, or your ×. This list never rings; the board's pushes are unchanged. UNMEASURED.
